name: rqbit
author: Viboplr
description: Find and download music over BitTorrent with no torrent client to set up: search torrent sites, pick single tracks or take whole albums, or paste a magnet link. rqbit fetches each one as a one-shot run — nothing keeps running in the background.

viewHeader.subtitle: Download music over BitTorrent into your library

binaryDependencies.name: rqbit
binaryDependencies.reason: The BitTorrent client that performs each download

apiUsage.reason: Run rqbit for each download and to list a torrent's files
Check whether rqbit is installed (the app owns installing and updating it)
Search torrent websites directly (The Pirate Bay, Nyaa, 1337x, BitSearch, RARGB)
Remember which collection downloads land in, your filter preference and which search sites are on
Hold a track rqbit fetched for the download window until it is copied where you chose
Download a track you picked from a torrent through the app's download window
Download a track by finding a torrent that has it
List rqbit in Settings → Providers so it can be chosen as the downloader for tracks with no source — it never plays anything
Read a downloaded track's title, artist and album from the file instead of guessing from its name
Rescan the destination collection when a download finishes so the files reach your library
